hero.headline: Hill Country Electrical Work,
hero.intro: New homes, panel and breaker work, EV chargers, hot tubs and everyday repairs. Owner Troy Perkins and his crew show up fast, keep you in the loop, and don't leave until you're 100% satisfied.

heroCards.title: Fast response
heroCards.text: Customers mention same-day visits, even in a freeze with the heat out.

heroCards.title: New builds to small fixes
heroCards.text: Full wiring for new homes, or a single switch moved across the room.

heroCards.title: Clear communication
heroCards.text: You'll know who's coming, what's wrong, and what it costs before we start.

services.title: New Construction Wiring
services.description: Complete electrical for new homes and additions, coordinated with your builder from rough-in to final.

services.title: Panels & Breakers
services.description: Breakers that trip or fail, worn-out panels, and capacity upgrades for new equipment.

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.description: Level 2 home chargers installed on a dedicated circuit, sized to your panel and your vehicle.

services.title: Hot Tubs & Spas
services.description: The dedicated circuit, disconnect and GFCI protection a new hot tub needs, installed safely.

services.title: Switches, Outlets & Lighting
services.description: Add, move or replace switches, outlets and fixtures, inside and out.

services.title: Troubleshooting & Repairs
services.description: Dead circuits, flickering lights or something that just isn't right: we find the cause and fix it.

reviews.name: Edgar R.
reviews.text: An electrician came out the same day to diagnose and replace a faulty breaker for an HVAC unit. The temperatures have been freezing or close to freezing. I really appreciate their prompt response time and professionalism.

reviews.name: Mike E.
reviews.text: I recently used Perkins Electric to help me on a house I am remodeling in town. They pulled the proper permits with the City and did a fantastic job. I recommend them.

reviews.name: Raina M.
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with Perkins Electric throughout the build of our new home. Communication was always great whenever we saw or spoke with Troy, Roger, and Jesus from the Perkins crew at the build.

reviews.name: Shelly W.
reviews.text: I've used Perkins Electric for 2 years for everything from light switch relocation to installing an EV charger to installing electrical for a new hot tub.
